newsitem.title: USA: Weather cuts Burlington Jan revs by $25 mln.
newsitem.headline: Weather cuts Burlington Jan revs by $25 mln.

text.p: Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp Tuesday said it expects January revenues to be cut by about $25 million from bad weather, but noted it is too soon to determine the weather's effect on the first quarter.

"The severe winter weather has continued through January and has been significantly impacting operations," Robert Krebs, president and chief executive said. "As a result, we have incurred additional expenses and currently we expect revenues could be off $25 million or more for the month compared with a year ago."
He added, "Since we are only a couple of weeks into the first quarter, it is too early to forecast the full extent to which these factors will impact our first quarter 1997 results."
Burlington today reported fourth quarter 1996 net income of $244 million, or $1.56 a share, versus with adjusted fourth quarter 1995 net income of $203 million or $1.32 per share.
